task_completion.description: Microsoft Edge browser is opened and active.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Microsoft Edge window frame, address bar, and UI elements are visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: The agent navigates to the Wikipedia main page.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The address bar shows 'https://www.wikipedia.org' and the Wikipedia portal page is rendered in the viewport.

task_completion.description: The agent triggers the 'Add bookmark' or 'Edit favorite' dialog.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A pop-up dialog or flyout menu appears, typically by clicking the star icon in the address bar or using a shortcut.

task_completion.description: The bookmark name and folder are set correctly in the dialog.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The dialog shows the name as 'Wikipedia' or 'Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia' and the folder selection is set to 'Favorites bar' or 'Other favorites'.

task_completion.description: The agent confirms the bookmark creation (clicks 'Done' or 'Add').
task_completion.visual_evidence: The bookmark dialog closes, and the star icon in the address bar often turns blue or filled, indicating the page is now bookmarked.

integrity.description: The agent used the browser GUI rather than command-line scripts to add the bookmark.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movement and clicks on browser UI elements (star icon, buttons) rather than a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent actually loaded the live Wikipedia website.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser displays the real Wikipedia landing page with its characteristic language links and search bar, not a local file or blank page.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply click an already existing bookmark for Wikipedia.
integrity.visual_evidence: Initial screenshots show the star icon in the address bar is empty/hollow before the agent interacts with it.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target URL is https://www.wikipedia.org/. The page title is 'Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia'. The bookmark is valid if saved to either the 'Favorites bar' or 'Other favorites' folder in Microsoft Edge. The domain pattern to verify is wikipedia.org.
